title: Ingestion inventory graveyard
description: Tables we used to load and deliberately stopped loading. See docs/specs/INGESTION_INVENTORY_SPEC.md §7.2. Entries are never deleted: this file is what makes "when did this table stop arriving" answerable, and `ol-dbt inventory check-removals` fails a PR that drops one.

deployment.description: The unit's deployment. Vocabulary membership is deliberately NOT checked: a deployment can be retired out of vocabulary.yml too, and the graveyard has to outlive it.

raw_tables.description: A list, so retiring a whole unit is one dated, reasoned entry rather than sixty copies of the same sentence.

retired_on.description: The date loading stopped, as best it is known — not the date the entry was written, when those differ.

reason.description: Why it stopped. `no longer needed` is not a reason; name the thing that went away.
